senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) slavery, servitude; status of a slave.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:32">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵈ</cite> <he>אחת בסוף שש עד שהוא בעַבְדּוּתוֹ</he> (not <he>בעבודתו</he>) one declaration at the end of the sixth year, while he is still a slave by law.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:5">Pes. X, 5</cite> (in the Passover night service) <he>הוציאנו מע׳ לחרות</he> he led us forth from slavery to freedom; <cite ref="Kiddushin 22b:6">Kidd. 22ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Horayot 10a:21">Hor. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>כמדומין אתם ששררה … ע׳ וכ׳</he> you seem to believe that I place a rulership upon you (by appointing you to office), I place servitude upon you (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 12:7">I Kings XII, 7</cite>); a. fr.
